segments.en: What are you being so laid-back about?! The enemy's right on our doorstep!
That's why! Let's get old man Alex to hand over some more machines!
Machines are no good to us if there's nobody who can handle them!
Right, right! What's the use if we've got no drivers?!
Sounds like they're arguing up on the bridge...
Le Caine's fleet is closing in on this city step by step.
The Iron Gear alone just isn't enough firepower...
And Quess has to go missing at a time like this...
Come to think of it, the Military Police really helped us out... I should go say hello.
Oh, Mr. Dastun. Thanks for the help back there.
Oh! You're Kanji, if I remember right.
We in the Military Police are going to take on the Grados Army too.
Let's both give it our best!
Don't worry, we can win! No... we have to believe we can win!
That's right.
Well, I've still got things to do!
So that's the Iron Gear's crew?
Yeah. There's no one more reliable to have on your side than that bunch.
We can't let them outdo us!
We protect our own city with our own hands!
Isn't that right... partner...?

rows.notes: [11]-[12] unlabelled; taken as Dastun continuing (rallying his men after answering the MP). [13] [jp] kept as 'partner' -- addressee not shown (possibly a thought about Roger, his former subordinate). | [editorial 2] address form unified: Kanji's [jp] is 'Mr. Dastun' in dlg_4015_09503_00 (r19 k16); 'Major' is kept for [jp] lines | [editorial 4] 'We of the' stiff for spoken line | [proofread 13] punctuation: question mark missing

segments.en: Huh? There's a ship landing at a time like this?
Bebop
Bebop: Interior
Hey! What are you doing here?
I just happened to be passing by. I figured I'd watch the show.
Heh... Is that so.
What about you? What are you up to?
Call it the code of the drifter...
Acting all cool. What an idiot.
Hehe... How much do you think one kill is worth?
What's that supposed to mean?
Y'know~ the Paradigm Corporation put bounties on the Terminator Police~!
That sly old badger...!
The Terminator Police are all unmanned, right?
No guilty conscience, and it's easy money!
Oh, really... I think I'll head back after all.
Won't you stay and eat something? I got paid a bit up front.
Maybe next time.
Just don't drag us down out there on the battlefield!
Yeah, yeah!
Ah, that ship...!
Spike's friends... So they came after all.
Hey, you!
Huh? Me?
Who else would I be talking to?
You're the one organizing the squads on the Iron Gear, right?
Yeah... I guess that's mostly me?
Then put me in your squad, right now.
Huh?
I'm saying I'll lend you a hand, just this once!
Whoa... You can't just spring that on me...

Add Faye to the squad
Turn down Faye's offer
Well then, I guess I'll take you up on it...
Thanks! You're pretty understanding, aren't you?
Now, make sure you keep an exact count of how many I shoot down!
Y-Yeah...
Faye has joined the unit.
The Red Tail has been deployed.
Come on, this is way too short notice...
You're such a boring guy.
Well, do your best, I guess!
Sigh... Did I handle that right...? Something tells me she'd be scary if I made her mad...
Don't let it get to you, Kanji.
There's all kinds of people in this world. If you let every one of them get to you, you'll never get by.
Y-Yeah...

rows.notes: [8] [jp] rendered 'the code of the drifter' (yakuza-flavoured 'duty among those who live outside the law'). [16] Spike heads back (to the Iron Gear) rather than staying on the Bebop. [32] two choice options, one per line. | [accuracy 4] subjects restored (Jet is speaking of himself) | [accuracy 5] verb restored ([jp]) | [accuracy 16] subject restored (Spike) | [editorial 16] [jp] is unimpressed; 'Oh, yeah...' read as remembering something | [editorial 39] 'now is way too sudden' ungrammatical/awkward | [editorial 42] clunky 'Somehow she seems like she'd be' | [proofread 2] location card format 'Place: Room' (style sheet)

segments.en: Kanji! How's the squad setup coming along?
Ah... About that...
Quess... She's gone missing.
Quess has...?
At this rate, we can't count on Quess's strength.
I see...
But... right now, what matters is how we stand up to the main Grados force.
...Understood.
Well? Have you settled on a way to counter the Grados Army?
Yes. As expected, we have no choice but to make up for our lack of strength with the lay of the land.
Around here, the Sea of Clouds closes in and the land narrows.
Even the Grados Army won't be able to break through so easily.
If we take out the enemy one at a time as they come through the narrow corridor, we can hold them off even with a small force.
That's why we absolutely have to defend Paradigm City, no matter what.
So this is our Liangshan Marsh, huh.
I see.
But then this fight's going to drag on...
And if it does, won't we be the ones who suffer?
No... If we can drag it into a long war, they're the ones who'll suffer.
Every city on the Gaia Continent is under Grados occupation, and they're all in ruins.
So they can't resupply properly, huh.
Their great numbers become their undoing.
Looks like we'll manage somehow.
But Le Caine must know all that perfectly well.
He's surely going to throw everything at us from the very start.
This fight will be decided by how well we seize control at the outset.
Fuhahaha!! Exactly right!!
You've grown, you Iron Gear whelps!
Is Master Asia here?!
Fuhahahahaha! Where are you looking?!
I'm here! Right here!!
Hyah!!
I've had a good, long look at how you fight!
Hahaha! In the short time I've been away, you've learned to fight splendidly!
Everyone! We can win this battle!!
That's right! If we join forces as we are now, we'll beat Le Caine for sure!
Yeah, exactly!
Ah...! Eiji!!
Everyone came rushing here to help!
Then the Janous Team too?!
Y-Y-Yes, sir! The Janous Team has just arrived!!
Let's do this!
With this, our strength's doubled!
Waah~! Big brother~!!
Hey, Fred. Have you been doing okay?
Hahaha! Save the chitchat for later! Get ready to intercept!!
Got it!!
Eiji has rejoined the unit.
Master Asia, Domon and Rain have rejoined the unit.
The three from the Janous Team -- Roddy, Barts and Scott -- have rejoined the unit.

rows.notes: [6] [jp] kept as 'Liangshan Marsh' (Water Margin rebel stronghold) -- fits Sai Saici's Chinese background. [jp] -> 'Janous Team' from glossary ship [jp] Janous (not in glossary as a team). [33] Scott's 'sir' added to suit his flustered, earnest reply to Kanji; [39] [jp] as 'Got it!!' to avoid 'Roger' with Roger Smith in the cast. | [accuracy 15] conjecture [jp] restored (was stated as fact) | [accuracy 21] project decision: [jp] = Master Asia outside his own intro | [accuracy 41] project decision: [jp] = Master Asia in narration | [editorial 33] fragment read as grammar slip (accuracy flag); stammer kept

segments.en: Wait! From here on, there is no turning back.
Are you fully prepared to meet Le Caine?

Not ready yet...
Take on Grados!
Hmm. There's no need to rush.
Very well!
Iron Gear! March out!!

rows.notes: [2] two choice options, one per line. | [proofread 2] style sheet: faction name plain 'Grados' (no article)

segments.en: Grados Fleet Flagship: Bridge and Fleet Command HQ
Your Excellency! A message from Lord Arthea.
Lord Arthea's forces are preparing to attack GEAR HQ, so they say they cannot come to support us.
Heh... Just as I thought.
But if anything, that suits us better.
Listen! Once we break through Paradigm, we press straight on into Asia.
We shall show the world just how incompetent the Black Knight of Arktos is.
Commence the attack!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Arktos' (missing from glossary; the character library entries use Arktos, other notes mention Arcturus).

segments.en: Hear me, all of you who have rushed here to defend Paradigm City!!
We may be a motley rabble, gathered here with differing beliefs!
But! Surely we all share the same loathing for the inhumane tyranny of Grados!
The might of Asia and Gaia is now united here!!
Meet the enemy with unshakable faith in victory!!

rows.notes: [editorial 2] 'the Grados's' awkward (accuracy flag) | [proofread 2] style sheet: plain 'Grados'; also clears the accuracy/editorial 'the Grados's' flag

segments.en: Your Excellency! Our first wave has been driven back!!
Gosterro! Hoist Julia up!!
Yes, sir!!
Ah...
Hey! Isn't that Eiji's sister?
How cruel... Taking a defenseless saint hostage...
You've sunk low, Le Caine!! Taking a hostage is cowardly!
Do not misunderstand! This is, if you will, a sacrifice to adorn the field of battle.
This battle shall decide which is superior: Grados or Terra.
What are you talking about?!
All you need do is defeat me. Do so, and I will free Julia and promise to withdraw as well.
But if I win, Julia... no... the Saint of Cusco shall be executed for the crime of leading the people astray!
What did you say?!
That's right! Don't go deciding that all on your own!
No matter!! If he says he'll keep his word, then we simply win, as we are!
Oho... As one would expect of the enemy commander.
Now, have at you!!

rows.notes: [2] [jp] = suspend her on display as a hostage (she is alive in later rows), so 'String Julia up' in the hoist sense, not an execution. [10] [jp] -> 'Terra' (matches 'Terran'). [jp] 'the Saint of Cuzco' per Julia's glossary position. | [accuracy 2] 'String up' reads as execution by hanging; Julia is suspended alive as a hostage (see notes, later rows)

segments.en: Oho... It seems they'll entertain me a little.
Otherwise, all my efforts to set the stage would have been for nothing.
Please wait!! Lord Le Caine!!
...What is it?!
I bring orders from His Excellency Gresco!
You are to withdraw your troops at once and return to Grados City!
What nonsense is this?! The battle has already begun! Would you shame me here and now?!
It is His Excellency's absolute order! Forgive me!!
Hey! You! What are you doing with Julia?! Give her back, damn it!!
Lord Le Caine! I'm terribly sorry!
I'll be taking the Saint of Cusco!
What?!
Nngh! Karla...! What is she thinking?!
Hahahaha! What's the matter, Le Caine?!
It seems your so-called sacrifice has gone missing!
What will you do?! Will you fight?! Or won't you?!
Nnnngh!!
I cannot defy Admiral Gresco's orders!!
All forces!! Withdraw!!
We'll settle this another time! But I will be back, mark my words!!
Fuhahaha! Insolent pup! Come at me as many times as you like!
Yeah~!! Easy win! Easy win!
Yeah, you said it!
Everyone came together like this and we won! It's the best!
Still, we can't just sit here celebrating. You saw the enemy's strength.
Heh... Maybe it was Le Caine's personality that saved us...
Unless we do more damage to that fleet, we can't leave this place.
So as things stand, we can't move on to the next continent?
Exactly. At the very least, we must sweep out the enemy forces remaining in Asia.
I see. So we liberate Asia before we take down Le Caine.
Indeed. Right now, that should be possible.
Oh, Kanji! Once maintenance is done, we're heading to the Asia Continent.
I know. We're going to GEAR HQ, right?
Well then, I'm counting on you!
Looks like we'll be with the Iron Gear for a long time.
Looks that way...
Say, Dorothy?
What is it?
How would you like to see the other continents? Along with Big O.
I'm going aboard the Iron Gear too?
Yes... I want you to come.
All right. I'll take care of loading the machine.
Yes, I'm counting on you.
Roger...
Hm?
I'm glad I can go with you.
Hey! Hurry up, Hokuto!
There's a Megadeus in the hangar!
Okay! Wait up, Ginga!
Wh-What's going on?
It's Roger's Megadeus. He says he'll help us out.
Huh? Roger will?
It's huge... So this is a Megadeus.
This is Big O. I'll be relying on you from now on.
Yeah, good to have you aboard, Roger!
Who's that over there?
Dorothy!
This is our mechanic, R. Dorothy Wayneright.
Nice to meet you.
Uh... y-yeah...
Still, you're incredibly athletic, aren't you?
You hadn't noticed? She's an android.
Huh? An android...?
She may seem a bit unfriendly,
but to me, she's the best partner there is.
Big O's maintenance is perfect.
I won't cause you any trouble.
Haha! Well, thanks.
Roger and R. Dorothy have joined the unit.
Big O has been deployed.

rows.notes: [19]-[20] one sentence cut across two pages; English cut at the same point. | [editorial 16] 'have some amazing physical abilities' stiff for spoken line

segments.en: Le Caine has only just pulled back, so I don't think there'll be another attack right away.
Let's head back to GEAR HQ while we can and work out a plan.
Aye, sir!!

rows.notes: [2] Blume's [jp] to Elchi kept as 'Aye, sir!!' (stock reply, not a gender call).

segments.en: Iron Gear! Can you hear me?
GEAR HQ is under enemy attack! Please come to our aid at once!!
Also, the enemy's main force is a black Dendoh... No... It's Knight Ouga!!
Knight Ouga...? Him again?!
Damn it! What's with this guy?!
Heh... So they've come. Sooner than I expected.
Which means they won the battle at Paradigm.
I must acknowledge their strength!
Lord Omega, are you ready?
They're here. We will now intercept the Iron Gear!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Knight Ogre' (library/speaker data; glossary machine is [jp] Ouga). [3] [jp] taken as Arthea (Knight Ogre's pilot, a known male).

segments.en: Ah! That's a Claudian ship! It belongs to the Redros Army!!
Why are they together with Arthea?!
The Redros Army must have joined hands with either Grados or Galfa.
Since they weren't with Le Caine, Galfa seems more likely...
And that business at the supply base... They were probably aiming to whittle the Grados Army's strength down just enough.
Kh... I can't believe the Redros Army's gotten this far ahead of us...!
I don't really get it... but Arthea's the one who set this up, right?
You've gotta be kidding me! Damn it!
Show me, Dendoh! Show me how much you've improved!
Omega Fokurosu! Launching!!
The Blue Falcon of Giganos is coming!!
Meio Plato...! That bastard~!
Watch out, Kaine. He's got the usual extras tagging along, too!
I know!
Those Practies! Of all people, they had to go and become the Redros Army's lackeys!
So what're you gonna do?!
What do you think? We've got no choice but to fight!
Come on! Here I go!!
All ships! Battle stations!!

rows.notes: [5] subject of the supply-base scheme taken as the Redros Army (Amuro's running theory). [14] [jp] = Meio's Practies, named in [16]. | [editorial 11] mixed third person + 'I'; aligned to Meio's [jp] line in dlg_2364_07303_07 (accuracy flag) | [proofread 3] style sheet: plain 'Grados'; bare 'Galfa' as in the corpus (37 vs 1) | [proofread 4] consistency: bare 'Galfa' (corpus form); verb agreement follows

segments.en: Lord Omega!
They're breaking through our center.
I believe it would be wise to pull back the units on our wings.
Indeed. There are enemy unmanned units at our rear. There's no need to push it.
How fragile, though... Grados machines alone can no longer win, it seems...
I would like our own forces to have a bit more depth...
I understand, but if we reinforce you too openly, we'll provoke Grados.
I'll have any ships you run short of replaced at any time.
Lord Arthea, I'd like you to devote all your efforts to capturing Dendoh.
Naturally. That is my intent.
Making Dendoh and its Data Weapons our own is the will of Emperor Galfa.
I, Arthea, shall see this mission through without fail!
We've gathered all the data we need. We'll be pulling out soon.
Then I'll cover your withdrawal. Leave the rearguard to me.
Until we meet again, Lord Arthea!
I have no intention of annihilating you now.
I must leave you enough strength to tear into Grados!
But for now, I'll be buying myself some time!

rows.notes: [2] [jp] = units deployed in the crane-wing formation; rendered 'units on our wings'. [3] [jp] kept as 'at our rear'; which unmanned force is meant is not stated. [15]-[17] Arthea addressing the player side. | [proofread 6] style sheet: plain 'Grados' | [proofread 16] style sheet: plain 'Grados'

segments.en: What are they up to? Doesn't the enemy even mean to win?
I guess he's covering the fleet's withdrawal... but why won't he fight us properly?
We've got to break through somehow! If we beat him, we can liberate Asia!!
Hokuto! Ginga!
Leave the rest to me!
Ms. Vega?
You! Why...!
My name is Vega. But by now, it's a meaningless name.
Just as meaningless as your name being Arthea!
Nngh...!
Mmmgh...!
Vice-Commander Vega has engaged the enemy commander! Let's hurry too!
Halt!
Master?!
Can you not sense it? The city is filled with an evil aura!
Mmgh...!
Could this aura be...!!
Protecting the lives of the citizens comes first!
Let's go!!
Right!!
Fuhahahaha!! Hiding is useless, humans!!
These guys! There were still some left?!
Fuhaha!! Diiie!!

rows.notes: [jp] from the boys -> 'Ms. Vega' (same treatment as the project's 'Ms. Diane'). [1]-[2] 'he/him' = Arthea, the rearguard. | [editorial 16] [jp]: 'Surely this aura is' read as certainty, not dread | [proofread 11] style sheet: [jp] 'Vice-Commander' (hyphen)

segments.en: Nngh...!
Arthea!!
Nngh!! Vega...
Vega...... How did it come to this...
Vega. Why must we fight each other?
What...?
Arthea... What do you mean by this?
Why must the only two siblings left fight like this...
Have you forgotten? Those peaceful days on Arktos...
Brother...? Could it be... your memories...!
Come with me! And together we will right every wrong.
Tch! It can't be helped.
We can't talk here. Forgive me.
Ugh!!

rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'siblings' (Arthea and Vega are brother and sister); [jp] -> 'Brother'.

segments.en: Knight Ouga...
What the? He's pulling out just like that?!

rows.notes: [accuracy 0] project decision Knight Ouga (not Ogre); term_fixes only catches 'Knight Ogre', and bare 'Ouga' would point at the other machine

segments.en: I can't believe Ms. Vega got kidnapped, though.
Yeah. We have to go rescue her soon...
Anyway, we have to head back to HQ for now.
Yeah!
Ah!
Huh?
What's up, Elise? Don't you have to be at HQ?
Yeah...
I've got business with the Iron Gear...
Hmm~ You seem pretty busy.
Sort of...
Oh, and also, they say you two can go home now.
Oh yeah? Let's go, Hokuto.
Okay...
See ya!
She seems to have a lot on her plate, huh.
And the city's taken... quite a bit of damage, too...
On top of that, Ms. Vega got captured by the enemy.
Yeah...
Looks like we don't have to go back to HQ... Should we head home?
Hmm~...
What should I do...

Take a detour
Go home
Let's take a little detour. I want to see the damage in the city, too.
Sure!
So much has happened, I'm worn out.
Let's go home.
Sure!

rows.notes: [7] [jp] = Hokuto and Ginga ('you two'). [12] subject of [jp] taken as Elise (busy, just left). [19] two choice options, one per line. | [accuracy 16] subject restored; [jp] is Ginga proposing for both of them

segments.en: Should we head home soon?
What should I do...

Not going home yet
Go home
I want to walk around a little more.
Yeah? So where are we going next?
You're right. Let's go home now.
Let's go, then!

rows.notes: [2] two choice options, one per line. | [accuracy 0] subject restored; [jp] proposes for both | [accuracy 4] verb and subject restored ([jp])

segments.en: Hey! Hokuto!
Dad!
Welcome home, Hokuto! And you too, Ginga! Did you have fun at the sleepover?
Ah... Yeah, kind of!
I see... Well, anyway, I'm just glad you're safe.
Hokuto, your dad has to stay at the station tonight because of that battle earlier.
Could you let your mom know for me?
Okay. Good luck with work, Dad!
Yeah! See you, Hokuto!
Your dad sure looks busy.
Yeah, but he's got nothing on your dad, Ginga.
Mine's a special case. I wonder where he's off reporting right now...
Ahahaha... Things are tough at your place too, huh.
Ginga's House
Hokuto, sure, it really burns me up how that guy carried off Ms. Vega, but
moping about it now won't do us any good.
Yeah! You're right!
We have to rest now so we're ready to move anytime.
That's the idea!
See ya, Hokuto!
Hokuto's House
Huh?
Huh? Why isn't anyone answering?
Mom...?
Mom...... I... made it home alive.
But... but... why aren't you here?
Mom...
